concept:
Create one polished full-body character concept illustration for the Hero warrior in our MapleStory-inspired defense game.
INPUT 1 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY / COSTUME reference supplied by the user. INPUT 2 is ONLY the established game ART STYLE and BODY PROPORTIONS reference, not a costume or gender reference.
Redesign the male warrior of input 1 in the refined smooth 2D SD anime rendering and approximately 2.06-head-tall proportions of input 2. Head height about 48.5% of crown-to-sole height, compact torso, very short legs. Keep him clearly male and recognizably the SAME warrior as input 1.
Identity must retain: voluminous short layered warm brown hair with swept bangs, vivid bright blue eyes, small silver hoop earrings, confident subtle closed-mouth smile, dark charcoal and silver plate armor with restrained gold edging and geometric gold engraving, red diamond chest gemstone, round silver cape clasps, black gloves, dark fitted pants, armored silver-and-gold boots, flowing deep red cape with very dark inner lining and gold border patterns. No helmet.
Weapon: one large two-handed silver broad sword with a gold-and-red gem guard, black wrapped handle and gold pommel. He rests the sword horizontally across the BACK of his shoulders with a raised gloved hand securely gripping its hilt. Blade extends toward image-left, hilt to image-right, never through his head or neck. Free hand relaxed beside body. Slight three-quarter turn toward image-left, both feet grounded, face fully visible, calm confident readiness. Cape frames the short body without hiding boots.
Art: precise thin clean colored outlines, glossy expressive blue eyes, softly shaded brown hair, controlled soft cel shading, polished 2D anime game illustration, strong readable silhouette at small size, same refined finish as input 2. Preserve reference1's mature confident warrior identity within chibi proportions. Not 3D, not pixel art, not flat thick-outline cartoon.
One character only, centered full-body composition including entire sword, cape, and both boots, generous clear margin all around, square canvas. Actual transparent background (alpha), no painted checkerboard, no fire, no aura, no particles, no environment, no floor shadow, no labels, no text, no watermark, no sheet panels. This is ONE approval-stage concept illustration, not an animation sheet.

rb01.prompt:
Edit the APPROVED male Hero character in reference image 1 into ONE clean transparent game animation keyframe. Exact same warm-brown swept hair, BLUE eyes, silver earrings, charcoal/silver armor with gold trim and RED diamond chest gem, round silver cape clasps, red cape with dark lining and gold patterns, silver/gold boots, ONE silver broad sword with gold/red gem guard and black handle. Same polished thin-outline soft-shaded 2D SD anime style, same head/body proportions and body scale across all frames, short legs. Facing IMAGE LEFT in three-quarter side view, both eyes visible. Focused determined expression, mouth closed, no grin during combat. Two hands grip the SAME sword hilt correctly, no extra arms/weapons.
Square 1280x1280 transparent PNG. Full figure and whole sword fit with clear margins. Fixed anatomical layout: crown at about y390, chin y620, feet at y1100, face skin width about 230px, feet midpoint x690, boots resting on same groundline; the weapon and cape may extend beyond body. BODY HEIGHT 710px, HEAD HEIGHT 230px is NOT desired: instead use crown y280, chin y650, soles y1100, so HEAD is about 45% of body height, matching reference. Keep body footprint centered x690. The animation changes ARM pose and torso twist; never stretch limbs or change armor. No background, floor, shadow, fire, aura, energy trails, text, panels, checkerboard, labels or watermarks. Render actual transparency. Only pose described below.
NORMAL RAGING BLOW FRAME 1, ANTICIPATION: crouch slightly, rear shoulder twists back, BOTH gloved hands lift the sword hilt above and behind the RIGHT shoulder, blade points diagonally up-right into clear space behind him. Face and chest gem remain clearly visible. This is preparation for a forceful DOWNWARD diagonal slash toward the left. Cape pools back toward image-right. No swing trail.
